title: Chick holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M60 40 Q56 55 52 66' stroke='#e0e0e0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='14' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='59,45 65,45 62,50' fill='#d63350'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='24' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- chick body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='20' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing reaching up to string -->
  <path d='M56 62 Q62 55 60 48 Q56 54 53 58 Z' fill='#f4b400'/>
  <!-- other wing -->
  <path d='M27 70 Q20 72 20 78 Q26 78 30 74 Z' fill='#f4b400'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='15' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M42 36 Q43 30 47 34 Q46 31 50 33 Q48 37 46 38 Z' fill='#f4b400'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2b2b40'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2b2b40'/>
  <circle cx='39.8' cy='48.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='48.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='42,55 48,55 45,60' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M37 88 l-5 6 M37 88 l0 6 M37 88 l5 6' stroke='#ff8c1a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 88 l-5 6 M53 88 l0 6 M53 88 l5 6' stroke='#ff8c1a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
